note: Unique Content Field Validation has NO settings page, no configure route, no permissions and no Drush. Uniqueness is stored as third_party_settings under the 'unique_content_field_validation' provider on three config objects: node.type.<bundle> (title), taxonomy.vocabulary.<vid> (name), and field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field> (field value, plus unique_multivalue for multi-value fields). Field enforcement is a widget #element_validate entityQuery; title/name enforcement is the UniqueContentTitle constraint that only fires when the bundle's third-party 'unique' flag is TRUE. Medium/hard cases read/write those third_party_settings on the standard Article node type and on a namespaced field_ucfv_* field, verified with drush against live config. Baseline for node.type.article has NO such third-party setting; cleanup/reset unset it.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with unique_content_field_validation enabled, how do I make a single field's value unique so no two Articles can have the same value? There is no module settings page — where do I set it?
evals.expected_output: Edit the field (Manage fields -> field -> Edit) and tick the 'Unique' checkbox in the Unique fieldset; it is stored as third_party_settings.unique_content_field_validation.unique: true on field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field>.

evals.prompt: How do I make node titles unique per content type, and taxonomy term names unique per vocabulary, using unique_content_field_validation?
evals.expected_output: Tick 'Unique' on the content type edit form (stored on node.type.<bundle>) for the title, and on the vocabulary edit form (stored on taxonomy.vocabulary.<vid>) for the term name. Enforcement is the UniqueContentTitle constraint that fires when that third-party 'unique' flag is true.

evals.prompt: With unique_content_field_validation, how do I prevent the same value being entered twice within one multi-value field, and how do I customise the duplicate error message?
evals.expected_output: On a multi-value field, tick 'Do not allow same value' (unique_multivalue) and set unique_multivalue_text. Messages support %label (field label) and %value (the duplicate value) tokens.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Article content type's configuration and state whether unique_content_field_validation is enforcing unique Article titles, and via which setting.
evals.expected_output: Yes — node.type.article has third_party_settings.unique_content_field_validation.unique = true, so Article titles must be unique.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a text field configured as unique via unique_content_field_validation. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ucfv_known: field.field.node.article.field_ucfv_known has third_party_settings.unique_content_field_validation.unique = true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use unique_content_field_validation to enforce that Article node titles must be unique. Apply the change to the live Article content type configuration.

On this Drupal site the Article content type has a text field field_ucfv_code that is currently NOT unique. Use unique_content_field_validation to make that field's value unique per Article, and apply it to the live field configuration.
